decision_conditions: The proposed two storey rear gable extension and rear dormer roof extension, by reason of their siting, scale and design, would represent an overly dominant and incongruous form of development that would erode the original appearance of the host property. The scheme would cause less than substantial harm to the CA1 Barnes Green Conservation Area of which it forms part, and there are considered to be no public benefits to outweigh this harm. As such, the proposal would be contrary to the NPPF, and the London Borough of Richmond upon Thames Local Plan (2025), in particular policies 28 & 29, as supported by the CA1 Barnes Green Conservation Area Statement and study.
application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Addition of a two-storey gable to the rear elevation, replacement of existing Upvc double-glazed windows, together with rendering of all elevations.
